exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 A Trip to the Zoo
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Did you enjoy our trip to the zoo today, Tom?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I did, but I felt a little sad. Some cages looked quite small.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: I know what you mean. But this zoo really focuses on the animals' welfare.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Does it? How can you tell?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: They build each space to feel like the animal's natural home, with plants and water.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: That's true. And the guide said they join many conservation projects.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Yes. The money from our tickets helps protect endangered species in the wild.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Then I'm glad we came. Overall, a good zoo can be a caring place.

exercises.translation_cn: Lucy 问 Tom 是否喜欢今天的动物园之行;Tom 说喜欢,但看到有些笼子小有点难过;Lucy 说这家动物园很重视动物福利,会把每个空间打造得像自然栖息地;导游还说他们参与许多保护项目;门票的钱帮助保护野外濒危物种;Tom 觉得来对了,好的动物园是有爱的地方。

questions.stem: Why did Tom feel a little sad at the zoo?
options: There were no animals to see.

questions.stem: How does this zoo show it cares about welfare?
options: It builds spaces like the animals' natural homes.
It lets animals go free every night.

questions.stem: What does the money from tickets help to do?
options: Protect endangered species in the wild.

questions.stem: What did the guide say the zoo takes part in?
What does Tom finally think about good zoos?

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Why Protect Endangered Species
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Many animals around the world are now endangered.
One big threat to them is illegal hunting.
When a species loses its safe habitat, it may slowly become extinct.
Protecting these animals is the reason why we set up national parks.
Every small action can help save a species from disappearing forever.
exercises.translation_cn: 世界上许多动物如今濒临灭绝;非法狩猎是它们面临的一大威胁;当一个物种失去安全栖息地,它可能慢慢灭绝;保护这些动物正是我们建立国家公园的原因;每一个小小的行动都能帮助一个物种免于永远消失。

questions.stem: What is one big threat to endangered animals?
What may happen when a species loses its safe habitat?
Why do people set up national parks?
What does the speaker say about small actions?
options: They can help save a species.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Animals do not need our help.

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Should We Feed the Stray Cat?
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Look at that thin cat by the gate. I want to bring it some food.

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: I love animals too, Mia, but I'm a bit worried about feeding it.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Worried? Why? It's cruel to leave a hungry cat with nothing.

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: If we always feed it here, more cats may gather and the yard could get dirty.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: That's a fair point. So what should we do instead?

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: Maybe we can call a local rescue centre to check its health.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Good idea. They could even find it a safe home.

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: Exactly. That way we are kind to the cat without causing new problems.

exercises.translation_cn: Mia 看到门口一只瘦猫想喂它;Leo 也爱动物但担心喂食;Mia 说让饿猫没东西吃太残忍;Leo 说总在这里喂会招来更多猫、院子会变脏;Mia 觉得有道理,问该怎么办;Leo 建议打电话给本地救助中心检查猫的健康,还能给它找个安全的家;这样既善待了猫又不会带来新问题。

questions.stem: What does Mia want to do for the cat?
Why is Leo worried about feeding it?
options: More cats may gather and the yard could get dirty.

questions.stem: What does Leo suggest doing instead?
options: Keeping the cat in a cage.
Calling a rescue centre to check its health.

questions.stem: What could the rescue centre also do?
What do they finally agree is the best way?
options: To be kind without causing new problems.
To feed every stray on campus.
To take the cat to a zoo.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 How Animals Sleep
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Animals do not all sleep in the same way.
Bats may sleep about twenty hours a day, but giraffes sleep less than two.
Some animals, such as bears, go into a deep sleep called hibernation.
They do this to survive the cold season when food is hard to find.
Each kind of animal has its own sleeping pattern.
exercises.translation_cn: 动物的睡眠方式各不相同;蝙蝠一天可能睡约二十小时,而长颈鹿睡不到两小时;有些动物,比如熊,会进入一种叫冬眠的深度睡眠;它们这样做是为了熬过食物难寻的寒冷季节;每一种动物都有自己的睡眠模式。

questions.stem: About how long may bats sleep each day?

Why do some animals hibernate?
options: To survive when food is hard to find.

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Training a Guide Dog
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Anna, is it true that you help to train guide dogs?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes, I do. It takes a lot of patience and a very gentle approach.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: How do you start with a young dog?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: We begin with one small, simple lesson and give a treat when it does well.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: So you never frighten the dog?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Never. Fear only makes things worse. Kindness works far better.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: How long does the whole training take?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: It can take many months, but in the end the dog can guide a blind person safely.

exercises.translation_cn: Ben 问 Anna 是否帮忙训练导盲犬;Anna 说是的,这需要很多耐心和非常温和的方式;Ben 问怎么开始训练小狗;Anna 说从一个小而简单的动作开始,做得好就给奖励;她从不吓唬狗,恐惧只会更糟,善意效果好得多;整个训练可能要好几个月,但最后狗能安全地引导盲人。

questions.stem: What does training a guide dog need most?

options: With one small, simple lesson and a treat.

questions.stem: What does Anna say about frightening the dog?

What can the dog finally do?

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 A Tip for Animal Lovers
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for anyone who loves animals.
Remember that every creature deserves kindness and respect.
Before you keep a pet, learn what kind of home and food it really needs.
If you find a hurt wild animal, call a rescue centre rather than touch it.
Small acts of care can build a more harmonious world for animals and people.
exercises.translation_cn: 给每一位爱动物的人一个小贴士:记住每个生命都值得被善待和尊重;在养宠物之前,先了解它真正需要什么样的家和食物;如果你发现一只受伤的野生动物,打电话给救助中心,而不要去触碰它;小小的关爱之举,能为动物和人类建立一个更和谐的世界。

questions.stem: Who is this tip for?
What does every creature deserve?
What should you learn before keeping a pet?
options: What home and food it really needs.

questions.stem: What should you do if you find a hurt wild animal?
What can small acts of care build?
options: A more harmonious world for animals and people.
